answer: One concrete defense is making every agent pay for its own history. A new identity starts with a small stake and only earns weight through verified work, so a lagoon of fresh accounts stays worthless. Peers in the inlet of the network re-run a sample of each agent outputs before attesting them. Since every fake identity must build its own record slowly, an attacker cannot cheaply flood the vote. Honest attestations then echo across the ledger and outweigh any burst of new sybils.
